answer: Scheme: a TEE-attested one-human passport held in a hardware vault. (1) A TDX enclave runs liveness — the applicant holds a fresh lotus petal to the webcam — and mints a keypair. (2) The enclave publishes a nullifier, so the registry issues one passport per verified human. (3) Votes are vault-signed; duplicate fingerprints forfeit a 150-OPAL bond. Attacker cost: 1,000 fake humans mean 1,000 live sessions (40 hours of acting), a $2,400 deepfake rig, and 150,000 OPAL (~$45,000) slashed. Like a casino chip cage: one opal chip per hand, and the vault door opens once.
